messages:
zara: deploy-bot alerted on eu-west1 canary for obelisk-rc1. seeing tokenizer errors + 5xx spike. need expedited rollback/pin. pinging @julian @tess for approvals.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary-e2e FAILED - 5xx_rate=3.1% over 5m on /v1/generate (eu-west1). Artifact=obelisk-rc1.

deploy-bot: ```
2026-03-21T12:02:58Z ERROR tokenization: unsupported token byteseq for obelisk-rc1
2026-03-21T12:03:05Z 500 POST /v1/generate svc=serving-core instance=eu-west1-b-04
2026-03-21T12:03:12Z METRIC 5xx_rate=3.1% window=5m
```

julian: oncall_d can you triage and confirm customer impact?

oncall_d: confirming. Repro locally against eu shard, 500 on requests with non-ascii prompt. Looks like new kernel selector in rc1 prefers int8 kernels but didn't include unicode-safe tokenizer fallback. Affects embed and generate routes.

zara: build note: rc1 intentionally disabled tokenization fallback to measure perf. mistake. hotfix = repin to obelisk-rc0 kernel selection and re-enable fallback quickly.

tess: we need expedited approval + short release note. Any EU-regulated customers affected?

maria: rollback steps: 1) pause canary 2) `deploy pin obelisk obelisk-rc0 --region eu-west1 --by=zara` 3) run short smoke (non-ascii prompts) 4) resume. I can execute. ETA 8-12m.

ravi: infra +1. rc0 artifact verified; config matches production.

tess: PM approves expedited pin. Ensure note mentions kernel selector/quant fallback and that no user data was exposed. :thumbsup:

zara: security confirms no data exfiltration. logs show runtime errors only.

deploy-bot: running: `deploy pin obelisk obelisk-rc0 --region eu-west1 --timeout 600`

deploy-bot: [ACTION] starting pinning operation. Pausing canary traffic.

deploy-bot: ```
2026-03-21T12:06:18Z INFO pin: initiating on 10 hosts
2026-03-21T12:06:34Z INFO pin: eu-west1-b-04 -> obelisk-rc0 applied
2026-03-21T12:06:48Z INFO pin: 5/10 hosts complete
2026-03-21T12:07:05Z INFO pin: 10/10 hosts complete
```

deploy-bot: Pin complete. Canary paused. 5xx rate fell 3.1% -> 0.1% within 60s. Latency stable. Rolling pin to remaining pool.

maria: smoke tests passing (non-ascii tokenization checks). marking smoke green.

julian: good. file short release note and customer advisory if any customers opened tickets. who owns postmortem?

zara: I'll own the postmortem and add CI guard: disallow disabling tokenizer fallback without explicit feature flag and canary gating. Also will append canary logs to the incident thread.

tess: include timeline + rollback command in release note. Approved for expedited rollback.

zara: closing thread. monitoring 30m. reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
